Kolter's plans gave its clubhouse a fitness center, and the clubhouse has a pool, tennis and pickleball courts and a lake path beside it. A house resold for about $540,000.

- Withers Preserve About 220 houses in three sections, Highlands, Estates and Sanctuary, on lots of about 0.19 acre. A house there resold for about $520,000.

- Park Place About 190 houses on lots of about 0.15 acre, with a pool and pool house. A house resold for about $525,000.

- West Lake About 140 houses on lots of about 0.15 acre. Only 6 resold in the past year, too few for a fair middle price.

- Balmoral About 120 houses on the largest lots here, about 0.21 acre, with a pool and pool house. A house resold for about $685,000, the highest of the neighborhoods.

- The Reserve About 110 houses on lots of about 0.15 acre, with a pool and pool house. A house resold for about $520,000.

- Sweetgrass Square 66 houses inside the town center district, about a 13-minute walk from Valor Park.

Kolter Homes' word for Cresswind was "age targeted", which is not the same as limited by age. Its rules on who may buy or live there are not published online, so we read them for any Cresswind home you pick. Our 55-plus communities guide covers the area's age-restricted communities.

## What do homes cost in The Market Common?
In the past year a typical house in The Market Common resold for about $525,000: half sold for less and half for more. The middle half sold between about $475,000 and $567,000. A condo resold for about $310,000.
A townhome resold for about $375,000 across the whole area. In the town center it was about $400,000, and in Emmens Preserve about $380,000. The neighborhood list above gives each one's house price.

## What does a Market Common home cost to own each year?
Besides the mortgage and insurance , a typical house here that you live in costs up to about $3,900 a year in property tax and HOA fee. A town center townhome costs about $6,400 to $7,600 a year, mostly because its HOA fee is higher.
Each year House Town center townhome
Property tax About $2,100 About $1,600
HOA fee Up to $1,800 $4,800 to $6,000
Together Up to $3,900 $6,400 to $7,600

About, as your main home: a house bought for about $525,000 and a town center townhome bought for about $400,000.
The fees are what the homes for sale list: most houses $150 a month or less, and town center townhomes about $400 to $500. Before you offer, we get the HOA's budget for the home you pick, so you know what the fee covers.
Inside the City of Myrtle Beach, a home you live in pays about $404 a year in property tax for every $100,000 of the county's value. A second home or rental pays about $1,528, about 3.8 times as much.
When a home sells, its county value becomes about the price a buyer pays, so your tax starts from your price. The lower rate needs an application to the county. Our property tax guide explains both rates.

## Is The Market Common in a flood zone?
Almost none of it is. Only 62 of about 3,000 homes in The Market Common sit in FEMA's high-risk flood zone, all of them houses:

- Cresswind 38 houses.

- Balmoral 14 houses.

- The town center 10 houses, on its own streets.

No other neighborhood has a home in the zone. At all 62, a big flood can bring rising water, but not ocean waves. A mortgage from a federally backed or regulated lender on a home in that zone requires flood insurance.
Another 30 homes are in the moderate zone, where a lender does not require flood insurance. Our page on flooding a seller may not mention explains how we look into a home's flood history.

## How loud is the airport next to The Market Common?
You will hear planes here, because the airport's runway runs along the town center's east side. Even so, no home in The Market Common is inside the area the airport's own map marks as too loud for homes. The FAA treats homes outside that area as suitable next to an airport, with no limits.
We placed every home's lot on the airport's map, for today and for its forecast in 2038. The closest home is about a quarter mile outside the loud area, on the town center's east edge.

- Where planes are too loud for homes on the airport's map: a yearly average of 65 decibels or more

- The town center district

The shaded area covers both the airport's map for today and its forecast for 2038. We traced it from the airport's drawing, so its edge is close but not exact. Aerial: USDA NAIP via The National Map (USGS), public domain. Noise lines: Myrtle Beach International Airport layout plan, sheet 14. Map: Chapter3 Realty.
The loud area runs along the runway and out past both ends, where planes take off and land. A small loud spot also sits around a helicopter pad near US 17 Business, at the runway's south end, used for oceanfront helicopter flights.
The airport's map uses a yearly average. A single takeoff is louder than the average, and planes are heard across the area.

- The town center The closest part. Its nearest home is about a quarter mile from the loud area, and a little over half a mile from the runway's center line.

- The neighborhoods to the west The nearest home in them is about 0.9 mile from the loud area. In Belle Harbor and the Sanctuary section of Withers Preserve, at the west end, the nearest is about 1.8 miles.

## What was The Market Common before?
The Market Common stands on the old Myrtle Beach Air Force Base, which closed in 1993. The town center opened on part of it in 2008.
The Air Force has closed 229 cleanup sites on the old base since the 1990s. In 2019 it said 15 were still open, among them old landfills and groundwater sites. It said every site is being cleaned up to the standard for homes, and that no limit on the soil or groundwater rules out homes there.
Photo: Erechtheus
Warbird Park on Farrow Parkway: an A-10, the kind of attack plane the base flew, and an A-7 beside it.
Three Air Force jets still stand in Warbird Park on Farrow Parkway: an F-100 Super Sabre, an A-7D Corsair and an A-10 Warthog. They are on permanent loan to the city from the Air Force.

Common questions

## The Market Common FAQ

### Is The Market Common part of Myrtle Beach?
Yes. Every home in it is inside the City of Myrtle Beach, so the city's zoning and tax rate apply. Nearly every home has a Myrtle Beach mailing address in ZIP code 29577.

### Can I rent out a Market Common home by the night?
Only in the town center. The city's zones for rentals under 90 days include the town center's zoning district, but not the neighborhoods around it. Each HOA's rules also decide, and we read them for the home you pick.

### Is Cresswind a 55-plus community?
Kolter Homes built Cresswind as what it called an active adult community, aimed at older buyers. Its rules on who may buy or live there are not published online. We read them for any Cresswind home you are thinking about.

### Can I buy one of the apartments over the shops?
No. The apartments above the town center's shops are rented by the year. The area's 37 condos are in High Market, south of Valor Park.

### Do the neighborhoods have pools?
On the 2023 aerial photo, seven of them have one. Cresswind has a clubhouse with a pool and courts. Emmens Preserve, Belle Harbor, Balmoral, Park Place and The Reserve each have a pool with a pool house or small clubhouse. Withers Preserve has a pool with a pool house in its Sanctuary section.

The short answer
Horry County keeps property records in three places: deeds at the Register of Deeds, tax bills at the Treasurer, and lot lines on the county's online map (GIS).
Our free lookup reads the county's and FEMA's public maps for one address. Its card opens that parcel's deed record and tax bill.

## Your mail says Myrtle Beach. The city line may not.
About 3 in 4 street addresses that say "Myrtle Beach" are outside the City of Myrtle Beach. The city in a mailing address comes from the post office, not from the town line. Across Horry County, about 7 in 10 street addresses are outside every city and town. We checked all 246,621 points on the county's address map against the town limits.

## Can you search Horry County property records by name?
Yes, in two county searches. Both ask for the last name first.

- The deed index at the Register of Deeds. It is free and needs no account. Our deed search guide shows the steps.

## What do Horry County property records not show?
Four things a buyer needs to know are not in the deed index, the tax bill or the county map.

- Unpaid HOA charges. A condo buyer and the seller can both owe the seller's unpaid HOA charges, up to the amount in the statement the association must give on request. Our agents check the balance before closing, and an unpaid fee is usually paid from the seller's proceeds. See HOA statements and transfer fees .

- Rental rules. Whether a home can be rented by the night depends on the town and the HOA, not on the deed or the tax bill. See the Myrtle Beach short-term rental rules and HOA rental restrictions .

- The cost of insurance. It is not a county record. See what coastal home insurance costs .

- Your own tax bill. Last year's bill can be the seller's, figured at the 4% ratio. Yours is figured at 4% if it is your legal residence, which you apply for, and at 6% if not. See Horry County property taxes .

## Pawleys Island and Litchfield: Georgetown County records
Pawleys Island and Litchfield Beach are in Georgetown County, so their records are Georgetown's. Our lookup reads Horry County's maps only.

- The map: Georgetown's online map opens with no sign-in. It searches by tax map number, address or road, not by owner.

- Deeds: georgetowndeeds.com shows document images online when it has them.

- Tax bills: georgetowncountysctax.com .

Pawleys Island itself is less than 4 miles long and mostly one house wide, with a salt marsh between it and the mainland. The island and most of the land around it share ZIP code 29585, so a Pawleys Island address does not always mean a house on the island.

## Horry County property records questions

### How do I find the owner of a property in Horry County?
Look up the address, then tap Deed record on the card. The county's deed record names the parties to that deed. The Treasurer's tax search, behind the Tax bill button, also shows the owner's name.

### Why can't the lookup find my address?
Type the house number and the street, then pick a suggestion. Without a house number, the county's address finder can match only the street, so the card cannot name a parcel.

### Why does a condo building show many parcel numbers?
Each unit in the building has its own parcel number, drawn on the building's outline. Send us the unit number and we find the right one.

### What is my hurricane evacuation zone?
Type the address in the lookup. The card's Hurricane line gives zone A, B or C, or none. About 1 in 3 street addresses in Horry County is in a zone.

### Who answers flood map questions in Horry County?
Horry County Code Enforcement has 12 certified floodplain managers on staff. To reach one, call its flood office at (843) 915-5090.

## Horry County Land Records: Free Deed Search by Name
URL: https://chapter3realty.com/buyers/property-records/deeds/

# Horry County land records: how to search deeds, liens and plats Deeds, mortgages and liens back to late 1979, free to search by name.
By Devin Day , Operations Officer · Reviewed by Tim Nash , Broker-in-Charge · Updated November 14, 2026
The Horry County land records search is free, needs no account and takes three steps. Reading the deed itself takes a trip to Conway or a copy.

The short answer
Horry County land records are free to search online at the Register of Deeds' search, with no account. Choose Name and type the last name first, like SMITH JOHN. The list shows the deeds, mortgages, liens and plats recorded under that name.
The list is online, but the papers are not. You read them in Conway, order a copy by mail from $8, or send us the address and we pull them free.

## How do I search Horry County land records?
Open the Horry County deed search
The search belongs to the Horry County Register of Deeds. Chapter3 is a real estate brokerage, not the county.

-

### Open the search and accept the county's terms.
Click "I accept the conditions above." You then search as a guest, with no account and no fee.

-

### Choose Name, and type the last name first.
Type SMITH JOHN for John Smith. Use at least 3 letters, and click Search.

-

### Read the list, then click a row.
Each row is one paper under that name. Click it for the date, the kind of paper, both names, the book and page, and the price. It also gives a short description of the land.

The deed itself is not online.
Send us the address. We pull the deed, the plat, any liens and the HOA papers for you, free.

## Are Horry County land records free?
Yes. Searching the Horry County deed index costs nothing and needs no account. The county charges only for copies and for recording a paper.
The index is online, but the documents are not. Horry County does not show images of recorded documents on the internet. You view and print them at the public viewing area at 1301 Second Avenue in Conway.
Photo: Pollinator at English Wikipedia
The Horry County Government and Justice Center at 1301 Second Avenue in Conway. The Register of Deeds' public viewing area, where the documents are read and printed, is in this building.

The free search still tells you a lot. It shows that a paper exists, when it was recorded, who signed it, where it is filed and what land it covers.
The county also has an app called "Land Records". It is a parcel map, not the deed search, and it asks you to sign in with a county account. Our GIS map guide shows how to use it.

## How do I get a copy of my deed in Horry County?
You can get a copy of a Horry County deed three ways: at the office in Conway , by mail, or through us.

- At the office. View and print the deed in the public viewing area.

- By mail. Send the county's copy request form with a check or money order to the Register of Deeds, PO Box 470, Conway, SC 29528. A deed is $8 for the first 4 pages.

- Through us. Free, by email, from the address alone.

What a copy costs at the Horry County Register of Deeds Copy Cost
At the office, on the copy machine 50 cents a page
At the office, copied by staff $1 a page
By mail, a deed or other document $8 for the first 4 pages, then $1 a page
By mail, a plat $5 small (up to 11 by 17), $10 large (24 by 36)
At the office, a plat $2 a page up to 11 by 17; $10 large, $15 in color
To certify a copy $2 more

The index shows the number of pages for each paper, so you know the cost before you mail the form.

## How do I search Horry County deeds by name?
Choose Name in the Horry County deed search, type the last name first, then the first name, and click Search. These are the four boxes that matter.
Name search
1 Name SMITH JOHN
2 Show Names All Grantor Grantee
3 From and To Record Date 1/1/1984 to today
4 Document Type DEEDS, MTG, LIENS, PLATS
Search

A drawing of the county's Name search, simplified. The real page has a few more boxes.

- 1

### Name: the last name first, then the first name.
Search every spelling too, with and without a middle initial.

- 2

### Show Names: leave it on All.
All finds the name on either side of a paper. On a deed, the grantor is the seller and the grantee is the buyer.

- 3

### From and To Record Date: narrow a long list.
The form fills in a From date of January 1, 1984, but names reach back to late 1979. For an older deed, set the From date earlier. A shorter range cuts a common name down to a few rows.

- 4

### Document Type: pick one kind of paper.
The four groups are deeds, mortgages, liens and plats. The table below names the exact types to pick.

A company is searched the same way, by the name on the paper. The index also searches by book and page , by price range, by recording date and by the legal description or memo .

## Can I search Horry County deeds by address?
Go from the address to the owner's name or the deed's book and page first. A deed's index entry describes the land by its lot and subdivision, so two steps are quicker.

- 1

### Find the lot on the county's parcel map.
On the Horry County GIS map , search the address and click the lot. Its card shows the owner and the Deed Book and Deed Page. The map asks you to sign in with a county account.

- 2

### Open the deed.
Type the book and page into the box below , or search the owner's name in the deed search.

To see every lot in a subdivision, use the Legal Description/Memo search and type the subdivision's name. Almost every deed, 999 in 1,000, carries that short description of its lot.

## How do I look up a deed by book and page in Horry County?
Type the deed book and page below, and the county's page for that deed opens. A book and page is printed on the county map's parcel card and in the index entry of every paper.
Deed book Page
Open the deed at the county Opens the county's page for that deed book and page in a new tab, with no terms screen.

For a plat, mortgage or lien book, use the county's Book/Page search . Pick the book type there: D for deeds, MTG for mortgages, LN for liens and P for plats.

## How do I find a mortgage, a lien, a plat or an easement in Horry County?
Search the owner's name, then pick the document type. The Horry County index has more than 140 types. These are the ones a buyer or an owner needs.

A loan against the home MORTGAGE (002)

A paid-off mortgage shows as its own entry under the owner's name. A lis pendens notice says a lawsuit affects the title to the property.

### What the deed index does not hold

- Court judgments. The Clerk of Court keeps them. A judgment entered there is a lien on the debtor's land in the county for ten years. The courts' Public Index searches Horry County's cases.

- Property tax. Whether a home's tax is paid shows on its county tax bill . Our Horry County property tax guide explains the rates.

- HOA dues owed. An association's claim shows only once it is recorded as a lien. Our HOA liens guide explains what follows.

## How do I read a Horry County deed?
Start with the deed's entry in the index. It holds the facts most readers need, and you can see it free, without a trip to Conway.
One deed's entry in the index
Record Date The day the county recorded the paper.
Book / Page Where it is filed. A copy is ordered by this.
Instrument Number The county's own number for the paper.
Map # The lot's parcel number. 99 in 100 deeds carry one.
Number Of Pages How long it is, and so what a copy by mail costs.
Doc Type The kind of paper, such as 001 - DEED.
Grantor On a deed, the seller.
Grantee On a deed, the buyer.
Consideration The price shown on the paper. Often $0 or blank.
Memo, Legal Description The land in short: a lot number and a subdivision name.

A drawing of the fields, not a real deed. Click any row in the county's list to see them.

### Deeds that show $0
36.5% of Horry County deeds show $0 or no price. That is more than 1 in 3.

Each dot is 1 in 100 deeds recorded in Horry County.
We read every one of the 30,339 deeds Horry County recorded in the 12 months to September 2026. 11,075 of them show $0 or no price.
You cannot tell from a blank price what was paid, and the index does not say why it is blank. State law exempts some deeds from the deed fee, such as an estate's deed of distribution. The full list is under recording fees .
For what homes sold for, see what homes sold for by area , worked out from the county's deeds that show a price.

### What the deed itself adds

- The kind of deed. In a warranty deed, the seller promises to defend the title against anyone's lawful claim. A tax deed goes to the buyer at a sale for unpaid property tax, once the owner's time to redeem it runs out.

- The owner and the previous owners.

- A full description of the land.

- The affidavit filed with it. A deed is normally filed with a sworn affidavit. It gives the tax map number and either the value the fee is figured on or the reason the deed is exempt.

Inherited a home? Our guide to selling an inherited house explains the estate's deed and the steps after it.

## How far back do Horry County land records go online?
The Horry County index lists names and dates from late 1979, starting at Deed Book 660. Older deed books, back to Book 1, show in the index only by book and page, marked non-indexed.
We checked the oldest books in the index. Book 1 still opens by its book and page, with no names to search.
For a deed from before late 1979, call the office before you drive to Conway.
The online list runs a few days behind the recording desk. A paper recorded this week may not show yet. About 2,500 deeds are recorded in Horry County each month, besides the mortgages, liens and plats.

## Does Horry County have a property fraud alert?
Yes. Horry County's Recording Notification Service is free for property owners. It sends you an email when a paper is recorded under a name you list.

- 1

### Open the county's sign-up page.
It is part of the Register of Deeds' search site, and the county's service page describes it.

- 2

### List every version of your name.
The name must match the recorded name exactly. DOE JOHN, DOE JOHN J and DOE JOHN JR are three different names, so add each one.

- 3

### Click the link in the county's email.
The alert starts once you activate it.

Sign up for the Horry County alert
An alert comes after a paper is recorded. It cannot stop the recording, but it lets you act quickly if a paper is filed that you did not sign.

Open the Georgetown County deed search

- New book codes: papers recorded after May 14, 2021 use RB for Record Book, PLS for Plat Slide and MLB for Miscellaneous Book.

- Old records: Georgetown County's property transfers and mortgages go back to the late 1860s.

### Horry County recording fees
Most papers cost one flat fee to record, whatever their length.
Horry County recording fees To record Fee
Deed $15
Mortgage $25
Mortgage satisfaction (a paid-off loan) $10
Plat $25
Easement $25
Mechanics lien $25
Restrictions (a neighborhood's rules) $25

The deed fee, often called deed stamps, is separate. It is $1.85 for each $500 of value, or part of $500, which is $3.70 per $1,000.
By law the seller owes the deed fee, except on a master-in-equity or government deed, where the buyer owes it. Our seller's net proceeds calculator and closing costs guide show it at your price.
State law exempts some deeds from the deed fee:

- A deed of distribution from an estate.

- A deed to a government.

- A transfer into a company or a trust in return only for an interest in it.

- A corrective or quitclaim deed that only confirms title the grantee already holds.

- A deed in lieu of foreclosure.

Selling without an agent? Our for sale by owner guide covers the deed fee and the other costs of a sale.

Common questions

## Deed search FAQ

### Are Horry County deed records public?
Yes. Anyone can search the Register of Deeds index online as a guest, free, after accepting the county's terms.

### Can I see my deed online in Horry County?
No. Horry County puts the index online, not the documents. You view them in Conway, order a copy by mail, or have us pull it for you.

### How much does a copy of a deed cost in Horry County?
By mail, $8 for the first 4 pages and $1 for each page after. At the office, 50 cents a page on the copy machine. A certified copy is $2 more.

### What is a plat, and how do I find one in Horry County?
A plat is a scale drawing of lots, usually made by a surveyor. It shows each lot's size and boundaries. Search the name on the plat and pick a plat type, or open it by book and page with book type P.

# Horry County GIS map: find any parcel, its lines and its tax map number Every lot in the county, with its lines, its zoning and aerial photos back to 1998.
By Devin Day , Operations Officer · Reviewed by Tim Nash , Broker-in-Charge · Updated November 14, 2026
The county's parcel map now opens on a sign-in screen. Three steps get you from that screen to a lot's lines, acreage and zoning.

The short answer
The Horry County GIS map is the county's parcel map, and it now asks you to sign in with a county account before it shows the map. Once in, search by address, owner, PIN or TMS, then click the lot.
The card gives the owner, the PIN, the zoning, the acreage and the deed book and page. The lines on the map are drawn for taxes, not surveyed.

## How do I find property lines in Horry County?
Zoom in on the county map until the lot lines show their lengths. Then use the map's own tools to measure and compare.

- Read the line lengths. At close zoom, about 2 of every 3 line pieces show their length in whole feet.

- Measure a fence run. On the Tools tab, Measurement Tools has Distance and Area.

- Turn on Building Footprints. We checked the layer: the map draws 417,124 building outlines, so you can see the house and the shed against the lines.

- Find the recorded plat. A plat is the surveyor's drawing of the lot, filed with the county. Our deed and plat search guide shows how to find it.

The surveyed line and its corner markers The county map's line, drawn for taxes

A drawing, not a real lot. The county draws its lines for taxes. A licensed surveyor finds and marks the corners on the ground.

## Is the Horry County GIS map accurate?
The county map is close enough to find a lot, but not close enough to place a fence. The county's disclaimer says its map shows parcels "as used for taxing purposes and not for survey purposes."
The county keeps two sizes for many lots: the acreage it lists and the area of the shape it draws. We checked every lot the county lists with an acreage, 85,490 lots, and set the two side by side.
On 4 in 5 of those lots, the two are within 5% of each other. About 1 in 10 is drawn more than 10% bigger or smaller. On a one-acre lot, 10% is about 4,400 square feet.
Half-acre to one-acre lots are drawn off their listed size most often Listed lot size Drawn more than 10% off

Under a quarter acre 5%
A quarter to a half acre 11%
A half acre to 1 acre 18%
1 to 5 acres 13%
5 acres or more 10%

Share of lots drawn more than 10% bigger or smaller than their listed acreage, by listed lot size. 85,490 lots the county map lists with an acreage. Our count from the county's parcel layer.
The differences go both ways: about half of these lots are drawn bigger than listed, and half smaller. The listed acreage and the drawn shape come from different county records, and neither is a survey. A difference shows the two disagree, not which one is right.
You can see both on the card. Acreage is the listed size, and Square Footage is the drawn shape's area. One acre is 43,560 square feet.

## When do you need a surveyor?
You need a licensed surveyor whenever a decision depends on exactly where the line is on the ground.

- A fence or a wall near a line. The county map does not show which side of the line a post is on.

- An addition, a pool or a shed near a side line. The zoning code says how far a building must stay from the lines. In the SF 10 district, a house stays at least 10 feet from each side line ( zoning codes ).

- A disagreement with a neighbor about the line.

- Buying land, or splitting a lot. The acreage on the map is not a survey.

- An HOA that asks for a surveyor's drawing before a fence or a shed, as The Farm in Carolina Forest does.

South Carolina licenses land surveyors through its Board of Registration for Professional Engineers and Surveyors . The board's licensee lookup shows whether a surveyor holds a license.
Buying a lot or a house with land? We check the lines before you offer.
We pull the county's records on the lot and tell you whether it needs a survey.

## What is the Horry County tax map number?
The tax map number, or TMS, is a 10-digit number the county gives a parcel to identify it and place it on the map. The parcel card shows two numbers, the TMS and the PIN.
Number Digits Shown on the map for
PIN 11 Every lot
TMS, the tax map number 10 About 3 in 4 lots

For a lot with no TMS, search by PIN or address. The county's tax estimator asks for the PIN.
For what the tax on a home will be, use our Horry County property tax guide . To find and pay a bill, see how to look up a tax bill .

## What do zoning codes like CFA, FA and SF 10 mean?
The zoning code on the parcel card tells you what the county allows on the lot and how far a house must stay from its lines. The table shows six codes you will see often on the county map.
Code Name What it allows
CFA Commercial Forest Agriculture Farms, forestry, homes, businesses, churches and recreation
FA Forest and Agriculture Farms, forestry, and homes, businesses and churches at low density
HC Highway Commercial Businesses along the county's roads
SF 10 Single Family Houses on lots of at least 10,000 square feet
MSF 10 Manufactured Single Family Houses or manufactured homes on lots of at least 10,000 square feet
SF 20 Single Family Houses on lots of at least 20,000 square feet

- How far a house stays from the lines. In SF 10 and MSF 10, at least 25 feet from the front line, 10 feet from each side and 15 feet from the back. The full table is in the county's zoning ordinance .

- Inside the towns. In Myrtle Beach, North Myrtle Beach, Conway, Surfside Beach and the county's other towns, the county map shows no zoning code. The town's own zoning applies there.

- How tall at the beach. The county map's Garden City overlay marks height zones of 35, 80, 120 and 180 feet. The ordinance allows new buildings in Garden City up to 35 feet. The exceptions are the areas its map shows and a Planned Development District, where up to 180 feet may be approved.

## Georgetown County GIS for Pawleys Island and Litchfield
Pawleys Island and Litchfield are in Georgetown County, and its GIS One Map opens with no sign-in. Search it by TMS number, address or road name.

- The TMS has 13 digits, typed with hyphens, in the county's own format: 05-0029-049-00-00 .

- Addresses spell out the direction and shorten the road type: SOUTH HAZARD ST, not S HAZARD ST, and HAGLEY DR, not HAGLEY DRIVE.

- To search by owner name, use the Register of Deeds name search . The map also links the Assessor's qPublic database.

- About 2 in 3 parcels have a plat reference. In the deeds search, a plat slide needs an S in front, as in S839-2.

- The state's beachfront lines are a layer: the baseline and the setback line along the ocean, the lines an oceanfront buyer asks about.

- The Swipe tool compares two aerial years, for example 2022 and 2024.

Georgetown's map has the same warning as Horry's: its layers do not replace a legal survey, deed or plat. Questions about the map go to the county's GIS office .

## Horry County GIS map questions

### Do I need an account to use the Horry County GIS map?
Yes. The parcel map asks for a sign-in with a county website account. Choose Register on the sign-in screen to make one. The same account opens the county's Land Records app.

### Does the county charge for a GIS map account?
The sign-up form shows no fee and has no payment step. To skip the account, send us the address and we pull the parcel card for you.

### Can I search the Horry County GIS map by owner name?
Yes. On the Search tab, choose Owner and type the name. The map matches every word you type anywhere in the owner's name, so the order of the words does not matter.

### What if my parcel has no TMS number?
Search by PIN or by address instead. About 1 in 4 parcels on the Horry County map shows no TMS, but every parcel has an 11-digit PIN.

### Does the Horry County GIS map show what a house is worth?
No. The parcel card shows who owns the lot, its size and its zoning, but no value for the home and no tax. An agent prices a home from recent sales of homes like it.

### Can I print the Horry County GIS map?
Yes. The Tools tab has Print Map, next to the measuring tools for distance and area.

### Is Chapter3 part of Horry County?
No. Chapter3 is a real estate brokerage. The GIS map belongs to Horry County. We pull a lot's county records for buyers and owners, free.

## Horry County Tax Payments & Records: Pay Online, E-Check Free
URL: https://chapter3realty.com/buyers/property-records/tax-bill/
Summary: Pay Horry County taxes online: search tax records by name, PIN or notice number, the card fee, the January 15 due date, installments and Tax Assessor appeals.

Home / Property records / Tax Bill
Horry County property records

# Horry County tax payments: find your bill and pay it online Search by owner name or PIN, pay by e-check for free, and do it by January 15 to avoid a penalty.
By Devin Day , Operations Officer · Reviewed by Tim Nash , Broker-in-Charge · Updated November 14, 2026
The county's tax search needs no account. Three steps take you from an owner's name or a PIN to a paid bill.

The short answer
Pay Horry County taxes online on the Treasurer's Tax Payments and Receipts site , and find a bill by owner name, PIN, map number or notice number.
Paying by e-check is free, and a card costs 2.35%. The bill is due January 15; a 3% penalty starts the next day and reaches 15% on March 17.

## How do I pay Horry County taxes online?
Pay on the county's tax site
The site belongs to the Horry County Treasurer. Chapter3 is a real estate brokerage, not the county. Use Chrome or Edge: payments do not go through in Safari.

-

### Pick the bill type and the year.
Choose Real Estate for a house, condo or lot, or Vehicle for a car or truck. The search holds about ten years of bills, paid and unpaid.

-

### Search by owner name, PIN, map number or notice number.
Type the owner's last name first. There is no address search. The PIN is on the parcel card of the county GIS map .

-

### Open the bill and pay it.
Pay by e-check or card. The county mails a receipt, and you can print a copy from the same site.

Have only an address? We find the bill.
Give us the address. We find the PIN and last year's bill, and send you both.
Have us find the bill
Deeds, the parcel map and the county's other records are in our Horry County property records guide . To find a deed, see our deed search guide .

## How much does it cost to pay Horry County taxes online?
Paying online by e-check costs nothing; a credit or debit card costs 2.35%.
How you pay No card Card
Online E-check: free 2.35%
By phone E-check: $0.50 2.35% plus $0.50
In person Check or cash Credit card: 2.35%
By mail or drop box Check or money order Not taken

- The oldest year comes first. While any older tax is unpaid, the county will not take this year's bill online or by phone. The oldest year must be paid first.

- The county keeps none of the fee. The card fee goes to the payment company. Visa, Mastercard and Discover are taken.

- By mail, send a check or money order to the Horry County Treasurer, with the notice number written on the check.

## When are Horry County property taxes due?
Horry County property taxes are due January 15, for the bill mailed in October. A mailed payment counts by its postmark.
Pay by January 15 and there is no penalty

Each penalty is added to the unpaid tax on the date shown. On March 17 the tax is delinquent.
Not getting the bill does not stop the penalty.

### Did my lender already pay it?
If your monthly mortgage payment includes the tax, held in an escrow account, the mortgage company may pay the county before January 15. The tax search shows each bill as paid or unpaid, with the date it was paid.

### Bought this year, and the bill went to the seller?
When a home changes hands during the year, the bill can go to the prior owner. If the new owner got no notice in time, state law requires the Treasurer to waive the penalty. The tax itself is still owed. At closing, the seller credits you for their share of the year .

## Can you pay Horry County property taxes in installments?
Yes. Horry County takes five payments ahead, each 16.67% of last year's tax, then mails a final bill for the rest.
Payment Due
Payment 1 February 15
Payment 2 April 15
Payment 3 June 15
Payment 4 August 15
Payment 5 October 15
Final bill, for the rest Mailed by November 15, due January 15

- Sign up between December 1 and January 15, with one form for each parcel. The county's installment page has the form.

- Real property only: land, buildings and mobile homes. Not vehicles, boats, or a tax a lender pays from escrow.

- Pay with the coupons in person, by mail or in a drop box. Installments cannot be paid online.

- The county holds the money until the last payment, then applies it to the bill. An owner who sells asks the Treasurer for a refund in writing, because a buyer cannot use the seller's payments.

- The packet comes again each year until you opt out in writing. An application can be turned down when older taxes are unpaid, the tax is escrowed, or the applicant is not the owner.

## How do you search Horry County tax records by name, PIN or address?
The county's tax search finds a bill by owner name, PIN, map number, notice number or tax ID. It has no address search.

- Owner name: last name first, then the first name.

- PIN: the 11-digit number every county office uses for a parcel. It is on the parcel card of the county map.

- Map number: the 10-digit tax map number, on the same card and on the bill.

- Notice number: printed on the bill. It finds that one bill.

- Only an address? The county sends address searches to its Land Records map, which needs a county account. Our GIS map guide shows how to get in and find the PIN.

Open a bill from the results to see its lines. The search needs no sign-in.
Real estate tax bill
Total Appraisal The Assessor's value of the land and buildings.
Total Assessed The taxable value: 4% of the appraisal on a home you live in, 6% on most other property.
District/Levy, City/Levy The tax district, and the town if the property is inside one.
Map Number, PIN The two numbers to search the bill again next year.
County Tax, City Tax, Fees Each tax and fee on the property.
Exemptions, Local Option Credit The credits that lower the bill.
Total Taxes What is owed for the year.

A drawing of the lines on the county's bill page, with what each one means. No real bill is shown.

### The 4% rate on a home you live in
A home you live in, which the county calls a legal residence, is taxed on 4% of its value. It also gets a credit that removes the school operating tax. The owner applies to the Assessor. Our Horry County property tax guide shows how to apply and what the tax on a home will be.
Paying the 6% rate on a home you live in is the costliest common buyer mistake here. For the full yearly cost of a home, tax included, see what it costs to own a home here .
Looking at a house? See its tax bill before you offer.
We read last year's bill for that house and tell you what changes when you buy it.

## What does the Horry County Tax Assessor do?
The Horry County Assessor values the land and buildings on the bill. The Assessor also reviews the applications for the 4% rate on a home you live in. The Auditor figures the bill, and the Treasurer takes the payment.
Assessor

- Values the land and buildings

- Keeps who owns what

- Reviews applications for the 4% rate

- Takes address changes

- Figures each bill

- Writes the vehicle tax bills

- Collects every tax payment

- Keeps the receipts

The Assessor does not take payments. Every payment goes to the Treasurer, online or at one of its offices.

## How do you appeal your Horry County property value?
Write to the Horry County Assessor within 90 days after a value notice is mailed. The Assessor mails a notice when a value rises by $1,000 or more.
In a year with no notice, you may appeal in writing at any time. In that year, one filed by January 15 counts for that year's bill, and a later one counts for the next year.

- 1

### Object in writing.
Use the Property Appeal form on the county's Tax Payer Services page .

- 2

### Meet the Assessor.
The Assessor schedules a meeting within 30 days of your request.

- 3

### File a written protest.
If the meeting does not settle it, you have 30 days to protest in writing, with the facts, your reasons and the value you think is right.

- 4

### Go to the Board of Assessment Appeals.
You have 30 days after the Assessor's written answer.

- 5

### Ask for a hearing at the Administrative Law Court.
You have 30 days after the board's written decision.

- The bill still comes. If an appeal will not be settled by December 31, the bill is figured on 80% of the protested assessment. The difference is billed or refunded, with interest, after the decision.

- Values reset every fifth year. The last countywide reset took effect for the 2024 tax year. Between resets, reassessment alone can raise a property's taxable value by at most 15% over five years.

- The 15% cap does not cover an addition or the year after a sale. Our property tax guide shows what a sale means for a buyer's tax.

- Who can present it: you, a lawyer, a CPA, an enrolled agent, or a licensed or certified appraiser on a value question. An enrolled agent is a tax professional the IRS approves to represent taxpayers. A real estate agent cannot.

## What happens if Horry County property tax is not paid?
Horry County property tax still unpaid on March 17 is delinquent. After a series of notices, the property goes to the county's tax sale in early December.
From a missed bill to the tax sale

- April 1 or soon after The county mails a delinquent notice.

- 30 days later A certified notice follows.

- May to October A notice is posted on the property: seized, to be sold for the tax.

- Three Thursdays before the sale The property is advertised in the newspaper.

- Early December The tax sale, at the county building in Conway.

- 12 months after the sale The last day the owner can pay the tax and costs and get the property back.

The opening bid at the sale is all the unpaid tax, penalties and costs, plus this year's tax.
Nearly half the properties on the tax sale list have an opening bid under $2,500 Opening bid Properties

Our count of the opening bids on the county's list, by range. The three shaded ranges, under $2,500, hold 843 properties.
The county's list of November 12 holds 1,772 properties, about 1 parcel in 170 in the county. A second list holds 459 mobile homes without land. Both lists get shorter as owners pay.
Buying at the sale has its own rules on deposits, bidding and the title. Our foreclosure and tax sale guide covers them.

## How do you pay Horry County vehicle tax?
Pay Horry County vehicle tax on the same county site. The tax is paid a year ahead, before the DMV renews or issues the registration.

- Renewals. The bill comes about a month before the plate expires. Pay it online or by phone.

- The high mileage discount is only given in the month the tax is due.

- A first registration needs the paper receipt. The DMV does not take the receipt printed after an online payment, so get the original at a Treasurer's office.

- A car bought from a dealer gets a bill that is due when it comes. If it is still unpaid 120 days after the purchase, a final notice gives 30 more days before the driver's license and registration are suspended.

- New to the area? The order of the steps is in our moving checklist .

If a property was not the home you lived in on December 31, the Auditor asks for a personal property return (PT-100). Furniture in a rental is taxed on its own notice; our rental setup guide covers it.

## Georgetown County tax payments for Pawleys Island and Litchfield
Pawleys Island and Litchfield are in Georgetown County, which takes tax payments online at georgetowncountysctax.com .

- Card or e-check online, through a payment company that charges its own fee. The county keeps none of it.

- The Treasurer is at 129 Screven Street in Georgetown, (843) 545-3101 , open 8:30 to 5 on weekdays.

- The DMV does not take the online receipt. The county mails an official receipt within three business days.

- Installments, five payments on last year's tax, but you apply every year by January 15, with last year's tax paid.

- Unpaid on March 17, the tax is delinquent, and the tax sale is in December.

- Values were reset countywide for 2025. You have 90 days from a reassessment notice to appeal, free, on the form at the bottom of the notice. The Assessor is (843) 545-3017 .

- A rental gets two notices, one for the property and one for its furniture, fixtures and equipment.

- Property records are on the Assessor's qPublic site .

Common questions

## Horry County tax payment questions

### Can I pay Horry County taxes by phone?
Yes, for a small fee, shown in the fee table above. For a question about a bill, the Treasurer's main line is (843) 915-5470.

### How do I get a copy of my Horry County tax receipt?
Print it from the Tax Payments and Receipts site: search the bill, then open it. A printed copy will not do for a car's first registration.

### I never got a tax bill. Am I still late?
Yes. The 3% penalty starts January 16 whether or not a bill arrived. The one exception is a home bought that year whose bill went to the seller.

### Can a Horry County tax penalty be waived?
Yes, in two cases. One is a home bought this year whose bill went to the seller. The other is a written request with clear proof you mailed the payment on time; the Treasurer's answer to it is final.

### Is there unclaimed tax money in my name?
The county keeps a search of unclaimed tax refunds, by name or notice number, on its Tax Payer Services page. A claim takes 3 to 6 weeks. Refunds dated before 2022 are with the State Treasurer.

### Where is the Horry County tax office in Myrtle Beach?
At 332 Hinson Drive in Carolina Forest, inside the county's Central Coast Complex.

### Is Chapter3 part of Horry County?
No. Chapter3 is a real estate brokerage. The tax site, the bill and the payment belong to the Horry County Treasurer. We find a bill or pull it for buyers and owners, free.

## Is My House in a Flood Zone? Horry County Flood Map Check

Buying a home

# How to check if a Horry County house is in a flood zone Look it up on FEMA's map before you make an offer.
By Devin Day , Operations Officer · Reviewed by Tim Nash , Broker-in-Charge · Updated November 14, 2026
Of Horry County homes for sale in FEMA's high-risk flood zone, about 4 in 5 did not come up in this site's home search filtered for flood zone.

The short answer
If the address is in zone A, AE or VE on FEMA's flood map, the house is in the high-risk flood zone. A mortgage from a bank there needs flood insurance.
To see the zone, type the address into our free property records search . It is also on FEMA's Flood Map Service Center , the official public source for flood maps.
Do not count on a search filter. We check FEMA's map for every house you send us.

Send us the address of a house you like. We find its flood zone.
Have us find the zone

## Does a home search show the flood zone?
Not reliably. We put every Horry County home for sale in our home search on FEMA's flood map, by its map pin. About 1 in 6 has its pin in the high-risk flood zone.
Of 1,122 homes for sale in the high-risk flood zone, 231 came up under our flood zone filter Horry County homes for sale in our home search whose map pin is inside FEMA's high-risk flood zone, counted on November 13, 2026.
Our home search finds a home under "Flood zone" only when the data that comes with the home says so. FEMA's map is the official answer for the zone. The gap shows up across the market:

- Condos. About 3 in 4 of the high-risk homes for sale are condos. A condo building also has its own flood policy, explained in our guide to condo master insurance .

- The wave zone. 108 homes for sale are in zone VE, FEMA's coastal zone where storm waves are expected. About 4 in 5 of them did not come up.

- Every price. At every price, fewer than 3 in 10 of the high-risk homes for sale came up. At $1 million and up, 45 of 59 did not.

The mismatch goes both ways. Of the 397 homes that came up under flood zone, 166 have a map pin outside FEMA's high-risk zone.

## Three steps to check an address
Three steps give you the zone, FEMA's own answer and a copy to keep:

- Type the address into our free property records search . It reads FEMA's flood map at the address, then names the zone and what it means.

- Check it on FEMA's Flood Map Service Center . Type the same address and read the zone letter at the house. The table below says what each letter means.

- Download or print the map. FEMA updates its maps, so a copy you print today can be replaced by a newer one.

Check each address, not the town. One town can hold both kinds of zone.
Photo: U.S. Geological Survey
Crescent Beach in North Myrtle Beach, seen from over the ocean: buildings on the beach, then streets of houses. About 1 in 3 homes for sale with a North Myrtle Beach address is in FEMA's high-risk flood zone, and the rest are not.

Horry County's own parcel map has a Flood Zones layer with FEMA's codes. Our guide to the Horry County GIS map shows where it is.

## What does my flood zone mean?
Each zone letter stands for a level of flood risk. In the high-risk zones, a mortgage from a bank needs flood insurance on the building.
What each flood zone letter in Horry County means Zone What it means Does a bank loan need flood insurance?
VE What it means High risk, on the coast, where storm waves are expected Bank loan needs flood insurance? Yes
AE or A What it means High risk: a 1 percent or greater chance of a flood each year Bank loan needs flood insurance? Yes
Shaded X What it means Moderate risk: a 0.2 percent chance of a flood each year Bank loan needs flood insurance? No federal rule. Some lenders still ask.
X What it means Minimal flood risk Bank loan needs flood insurance? No federal rule. Some lenders still ask.

A 1 percent chance of a flood each year adds up to a 1 in 4 chance or more over 30 years.
What flood insurance costs here is in our guide to coastal insurance in Myrtle Beach . For a house on the water, our waterfront homes guide shows where zone VE reaches.
Some houses are built up off the ground, on pilings. The homes below are listed that way.

## When will the lender tell me the house is in a flood zone?
If the house is in the high-risk zone, a regulated lender must tell you in writing, a reasonable time before the loan closes.

- The wait for a policy. A National Flood Insurance Program policy bought while the mortgage is made starts with no wait. Most others wait 30 days.

- Before you offer. Get the zone and a flood insurance quote, so the cost is part of the price you offer.

Whether the house has flooded before is a separate question. Our guide to finding out if a house has flooded covers it.
Send us the address. We get the flood quote before you offer.
We find the house's flood zone and get a flood insurance quote before you sign a contract.
Get a flood zone check and quote

## Does the house have an elevation certificate?
An elevation certificate records how high a building's lowest floor is, measured from sea level.

- Why you want one. FEMA's flood insurance site says an elevation certificate is not required to buy flood insurance, but it can help you pay less.

- When the rules require one. A building built or substantially improved in the high-risk zone must have its lowest floor height on record. Federal rules name the elevation certificate as that proof.

- Where to find one. Horry County posts the signed elevation certificates it has on file, by year and permit number: about 1,700 from 2010 to 2025. They are listed by permit, not by address, and an older house may have none.

We look for the certificate when you send us an address. For the other things we look at before an offer, see our list of common buyer mistakes in Myrtle Beach .

Common questions

## Flood zone check FAQ

### Is there a Horry County flood map PDF?
Yes. FEMA's Flood Map Service Center lets you download or print the official flood map for any address in the county.

### How new is Horry County's flood map?
The countywide map took effect in December 2021. FEMA has revised four small areas of it since, most recently in September 2026.

### Does Zone X mean I do not need flood insurance?
No federal rule makes you buy it in Zone X, but some lenders still ask. FEMA recommends flood insurance even where a lender does not require it.

### Can I use private flood insurance for the loan?
Yes, if the policy meets the federal rule. Under federal law, a lender must accept private flood insurance that does. A private policy has its own wait before it starts.

### Does a cash buyer get the flood zone notice?
No. The written notice comes from a lender with the loan, so a cash buyer gets none.

## Land around Loris and Aynor: river landings, longleaf pine and old farms
The country around Loris and Aynor has the lowest land prices we counted, and a long history as farm land.

### Around Loris
By 1903, tobacco markets were thriving in Conway and Loris. By the 1920s, Horry grew more tobacco than any other county in South Carolina.
West of Loris, between Green Sea and Nichols, Cartwheel Bay Heritage Preserve has a 3.5-mile trail through longleaf and loblolly pine. Wild Venus flytraps, pitcher plants and orchids grow along it. It is open dawn to dusk, with no fee.
U.S. government aerial photo, 2023
Country land outside Loris from above: wide lots along two country roads, plowed fields, pine woods and a wet hollow.

### Around Aynor
Galivants Ferry is west of Aynor, where US 501 crosses the Little Pee Dee River. There is a public boat landing on each side of the bridge. People fish the river for bluegill, redbreast, bass, crappie and catfish. Downriver, below the US 378 bridge, its state scenic stretch has tea-colored water, cypress-tupelo swamps and sandbars.
Since the 1870s, candidates have come to Galivants Ferry to speak at the Stump . These days they speak from the porch of the Holliday family store, and the crowd eats chicken bog and barbecue. What living in these towns is like is in our guide to which town fits you .

### Around Conway and Longs
Around Conway an acre is listed at about $51,000, and in Longs at about $73,000. At Longs, the county runs two boat landings on the Waccamaw River: Chris Anderson Landing on SC 9 and Danny Knight Landing at Red Bluff. Our Conway guide covers the city and its edges.

From Chapter3's files. Clients of ours from North Carolina bought land in Longs and built a new house there with a builder.

## Do you need a perc test to buy land in South Carolina?
No. South Carolina has not used perc tests since the late 1970s, because a lot can pass in a dry season and fail in a wet one. A state inspector reads the soil instead.
Where no public or community sewer reaches a lot, you need the state's septic permit before you build a house or place a manufactured home. Without it, the county will not issue a building permit. The state's steps:

- Apply online, for $150. The application needs a copy of the deed, or of the survey map filed for the lot. Our guide to finding a deed in Horry County shows where to get both.

- The inspector bores the soil. Under the state's traditional method, an inspector visits the lot and takes at least two soil borings where the septic system would go. The soil's color shows how high the water table rises in the wettest season.

- Wet soil can wait. If the soil is too wet, the visit may be put off until it dries out. Poor soil can limit the number of bedrooms the house may have.

- The permit is good for five years. If the site passes, the state issues a Permit to Construct.

### What the lot needs room for
The drainfield is sized at 120 gallons a day per bedroom. A three-bedroom house needs a drainfield big enough for about 360 gallons a day, plus a spare repair area half its size.
The system must sit at least 75 feet from a private well or a creek, pond or other surface water, and 25 feet from a drainage ditch.
If a lot fails the state's conventional and alternative standards, an engineer and a soil scientist can check whether it can take an engineered system. That can cost thousands of dollars more. Not every lot can take a septic system.

### What the listings say
About 1 in 4 Horry land listings are marked "perc or septic approved". We ask the seller for the state's permit itself, not the word "perc". If there is none, we can write your offer so it depends on the lot passing.
No sewer on the lot?
We look for a septic permit on it, ask whether sewer can reach it, and tell you what the soil visit will look for.
Have us check the septic

## Is there public water and sewer, or do you need a well?
Many lots have public water, and fewer have public sewer: about 4 in 10 Horry land listings list public water, and about 1 in 3 list public sewer. Only 41 list a well.
With no public sewer you need a septic system, and with no public water you need a well. Before you offer, we ask the local provider whether each one reaches the lot.
Grand Strand Water and Sewer Authority began east of the Intracoastal Waterway in Horry County. It now serves from the North Carolina line to parts of Georgetown County, and rural areas west of the Waccamaw River. Inside the City of Loris, the city runs water and sewer .
A new drinking-water well needs a state notice with a $70 fee, and a South Carolina certified well driller must drill it.
A listing that says nothing about water or sewer is not proof either way, so we ask the provider.

## What can you build on land in Horry County?
Outside the towns, each county zone has its own smallest lot for a home and its own rule on manufactured homes. In the two forest and farm zones, FA and CFA, a house or a manufactured home needs at least half an acre, 90 feet wide.
Zone, outside the towns Smallest lot for a home Mobile homes
FA and CFA (Forest Agriculture, Commercial Forest Agriculture) Half an acre Allowed
RE (Rural Estates) 1 acre Not allowed
AG4 and AG5 5 acres Allowed in AG5 only
AG6 and AG7 1.5 acres Allowed in AG7 only
SF6 to SF40 6,000 to 40,000 sq ft Not allowed
MSF6 to MSF40 6,000 to 40,000 sq ft Allowed

In Limited Forest Agriculture (LFA), a home needs 1 acre. A lot recorded before the county's zoning ordinance can still be built on if it is no more than 25 percent short of its zone's minimum.
Our count, at each listing's map point: about half of all Horry land listings are in FA or CFA. Among tracts of an acre or more, 6 in 10 are. Another 62 are in SF zones, where no mobile home is allowed.
We look up the zone of any lot you send us. Our guide to the Horry County GIS map shows where the county keeps it.

### Deed restrictions
A deed restriction is a rule recorded with the land. It can bar a mobile home even where the zoning allows one. In our count, 74 Horry land listings mention deed restrictions, and 111 are marked as allowing a mobile home. We read the recorded restrictions before you offer. To look up a parcel yourself, use our Horry County property records search .

### Can you live in a camper on your land?
Only for part of each month, and only in some places. On land zoned LFA, FA or CFA that touches the Waccamaw River or lies north and west of it, you can keep up to two campers or RVs. The land must have no house or business on it, and you can stay in them up to 15 days a month.
Each camper must be tagged, registered and road-ready, on approved sewer or septic, with permitted power.

## Does land in Horry County need road frontage?
Yes, for a new lot. A new lot must have at least 50 feet of frontage on a street. On a cul-de-sac, 25 feet is enough if the lot is 50 feet wide at the building line.
For a lot with no frontage that existed before the zoning ordinance, the county's planning commission decides whether private access is enough to build.
Along some highways, the front of a lot cannot be built on. Outside the towns, no structure may stand within 60 feet of the right of way of certain highways. They include Highways 701, 905 and 917, and two named stretches of Highway 9.
In our count, 77 land listings are marked as on a dirt or gravel road, 49 on a private road and 27 reached by an easement. For those, we find out who keeps up the road and get a copy of the recorded easement.

## Is the land in a flood zone?
About 1 in 8 Horry land listings (91 of 763) sit in FEMA's high-risk flood zone at the listing's map point, and 24 more in the moderate zone. A big tract can reach into a flood zone away from that point.
In the unincorporated county, a new home in the high-risk zone must have its lowest floor at least 3 feet above the 100-year flood height. The county asks for more papers before it issues the permit.

### Wetlands
If part of a lot may be a wetland, you may need to ask the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers or the state's Bureau of Coastal Management.
Our flood zone check guide shows how to read a flood map. Our guide to finding past flooding shows how to learn whether a place has flooded before.
Big tract near a creek or a swamp?
One map point can miss a flood zone. We look at the flood map across the whole tract, and tell you what a house there needs.

## Is farm and timber land taxed less in South Carolina?
Yes, when it is in real farm or timber use and the owner applies to the assessor. The land is then taxed on its farm-use value, not its market value.

- Timber land must be 5 acres or more, with trees grown for sale.

- Other farm land must be 10 acres or more, or a smaller tract that earned at least $1,000 in gross farm income in three of five years.

- After a change of use, such as a new house, the land owes rollback taxes. They are the difference between the farm-use tax and the full tax, for the year of the change and up to three years before it.

- Your own home and up to 5 acres around it are taxed at the 4 percent rate when you live there and apply.

How the county works out a tax bill is on our Horry County property tax page .

## Assisted living vs. nursing home vs. independent living: what is the difference?
Each choice gives a different amount of care. In South Carolina, assisted living is licensed as a "community residential care facility", and the state's papers use both names.
Choice What you get Cost a month here When more care is needed
Your own home, with help Your house or condo, and a caregiver who comes in by the hour. $31 an hour Add hours, or move to a place that gives care.
Independent living An apartment or a home with no care included. The state has no license for it. No published local figure Hire help at home, or move to assisted living.
Assisted living A room, at least three meals a day, and help with dressing, walking, bathing and taking medicines. $5,850 A nurse may come for up to 14 days in a row. Past that, a move.
Memory care Alzheimer's care, often in its own unit of an assisted living home. No published local figure The same limits as assisted living.
Nursing home An organized nursing staff that gives nursing care. $8,900 shared, $9,900 private The level of care assisted living may not give.
Continuing care One contract: an apartment or a cottage, and access to more care as needs change. An entrance fee; each campus has its own More care, under the same contract.

Assisted living may not admit or keep a person who needs nursing home care or a nurse's daily attention. When the home's care, even with outside home health or hospice care, no longer meets a person's needs, the person must move within 30 days.
South Carolina's health facility licensing law has no license for independent living. A home with room, board and personal help must be licensed as residential care.

### Apartments with HUD rent help
HUD pays subsidies to the owners of some apartment buildings to keep rents affordable for people with low incomes, including older adults. They are rental apartments, and none is on the state's list of licensed care homes.
In Horry County, HUD lists four of these buildings for older adults, with 228 apartments; one, with 110, is partly for people with disabilities. Two are in Myrtle Beach, one in Conway and one in Loris. One more is in Pawleys Island, with 48.
HUD's Resource Locator shows each building on a map. Ask the building's office about openings and who may rent there.

## Memory care and nursing homes around Myrtle Beach
On the state's facility map, 14 of Horry County's 20 licensed assisted living homes are marked for Alzheimer care, and 13 are marked with an Alzheimer unit.
Horry County has 8 licensed nursing homes with 824 beds. Three are in Conway and three in Myrtle Beach, with one each in Murrells Inlet and Loris. Seven of the eight are certified for both Medicare and Medicaid, and one for Medicare only. Certification is not a promise of an open Medicaid bed.
The county also has 3 licensed adult day care centers, in Myrtle Beach, Conway and Loris, and a 36-bed hospice house in Myrtle Beach. Medicare's Care Compare has a page for each nursing home.

### Who pays for long-term care

- Medicare does not. Medicare and most health insurance, including Medigap, do not pay for long-term care, in a nursing home or at home. Medicaid may, for people who meet the state's rules.

- South Carolina's Optional State Supplementation (OSS) helps people 65 or older, blind or disabled, whose income and savings are under its limits. It pays toward a licensed assisted living home enrolled in OSS, for a person with an approved OSS slot.

- OSS is not Medicaid. It is a separate state program, run by the South Carolina Department of Health and Human Services .

## Continuing care: two licensed campuses on the Grand Strand
South Carolina licenses 33 continuing care retirement communities. Two are on the Grand Strand: Brightwater in Myrtle Beach and The Lakes at Litchfield in Pawleys Island.
A continuing care retirement community offers, under one contract, an apartment or a cottage and access to a range of long-term care as a resident's needs change. The resident pays an entrance fee, which holds the resident's place.
Under South Carolina law, the person who signs has four protections:

- The refund. The contract must say what part of the entrance fee is refundable.

- 30 days to cancel. The resident may cancel within 30 days of signing. The refund is what was paid, less the community's costs and, if the home was ready to move into, a daily rate from the eighth day.

- A disclosure statement. By the time the contract is signed or any money is paid, whichever comes first, the community must give one.

- A check of the finances. The state checks a community's finances before it grants a license.

## When does buying a home still make sense?
For a couple or a parent who does not need daily care yet, a smaller home here can cost far less each year. A one-level house or a condo with an elevator keeps every room within reach.
Outside the city limits, a $400,000 house you live in costs about $1,380 a year in county tax and stormwater fee at 65. Insurance and any HOA fee are extra. A year of assisted living costs about $70,200. The tax rules at 65 are on our retiring to Myrtle Beach page .

### The beach, by wheelchair
Horry County lends beach wheelchairs free on the beaches it runs. Ask at least two days ahead; chairs are limited. In Surfside Beach , special beach wheelchairs are available through the town's police department, and five beach accesses have wheelchair access.

Common questions

## Senior living questions

### Does Medicare pay for assisted living in South Carolina?
No. Medicare and Medigap do not pay for long-term care, in a nursing home or in the community. Medicaid can, for those who qualify.

### Is there help paying for assisted living in South Carolina?
Yes, for some people. A state program called Optional State Supplementation helps pay for a licensed assisted living home enrolled in it, for a person with an approved slot. It is for people 65 or older, blind or disabled, under its income and savings limits. It is not Medicaid.

### Do assisted living homes near Myrtle Beach have a hurricane plan?
Yes. Each licensed assisted living home must have a written evacuation plan, made with the county's emergency agency and updated every year. A resident or the resident's responsible party can ask to read it.

### Is independent living licensed in South Carolina?
No. South Carolina licenses assisted living and nursing homes, but it has no license for independent living with no care.

### What does adult day care cost in Myrtle Beach?
About $72 a day at the middle, or about $1,560 a month at five days a week. Horry County has 3 licensed adult day care centers, in Myrtle Beach, Conway and Loris.

### How much is memory care in Myrtle Beach?
There is no published local figure: the cost survey does not price memory care on its own. Prices differ from one home to the next.

Where several list a fee, the table shows the middle half of them. Where too few give one, we find it for you. "Fee includes" and "Amenities listed" are what half or more of the listings say.

Not in the table, or serious about one home?
A neighborhood needs 3 homes for sale to be in the table. Cresswind Myrtle Beach, with its 12,000-square-foot clubhouse and outdoor amphitheater, had fewer. Send us any name or address, and we find its HOA fee. For a home you are serious about, we get the HOA's budget, rules and any second fee.

Close to 9 in 10 homes for sale in these neighborhoods list an HOA fee, outside the campground and leased-land communities. Some owners pay a second fee, and some pay a lot rent instead.

- The Farm at Carolina Forest. Owners in The Orchards pay about $225 to $255 a month in all. In Planters Point, it is about $450 to $500.

- Del Webb at Grande Dunes . The fee is about $400 a month for a house and about $445 for a villa. Every owner also pays a mandatory Beach Club fee to the Grande Dunes master association, on top of that.

A listing may show one fee or both. Our page on HOAs and POAs explains a neighborhood with two associations.

## Why are townhome HOA fees higher?
The fee covers more. In the middle townhome neighborhood the HOA fee is about $250 a month, more than twice the fee for houses. Counted home by home instead, the middle townhouse fee is about $290, as our Myrtle Beach HOA fees guide shows.

### What a townhome fee includes
Of the townhouse listings that give a fee, 84 in 100 say it includes lawn care, 72 in 100 trash pickup and 37 in 100 insurance. For houses it is 8, 46 and 4 in 100. Pest control, cable and water and sewer also show up in townhouse listings, and almost never in house listings.

### How to compare it with a house
A townhome fee buys more items, not the same items at a higher price. A house owner usually does those jobs alone and pays for them apart from the HOA. To compare a house fee with a townhome fee, add what you would pay for the same items on the house.
The listing says the fee includes insurance. It does not say which policy. Ask the HOA what its insurance covers and what yours must cover.

For a condo, each oceanfront building's fee is on our condo buildings page . To add the HOA fee to the tax and insurance for a year, use our cost to own page . How much an HOA may raise its fee is on our dues increases page .

## HOA fees by neighborhood: FAQ

### What is the HOA fee in Lakeside Crossing in Conway?
Lakeside Crossing has no HOA fee. The homes are on leased land in a 55+ community, and the lot rent is the monthly cost.

### Why does a listing's HOA fee differ from the HOA's?
A home's listed fee is what its agent typed for that home. A home in two associations may list one fee or both. We get the HOA's own figure before you offer.

### Is the HOA fee part of the monthly cost of a home?
Yes. Add it to the property tax and the insurance. Our cost to own page adds them up for a year.

### Why are townhome HOA fees higher?
The fee covers more. Most townhouse listings that give a fee say it includes lawn care and trash pickup, and fewer than 1 in 10 house listings include lawn care. Insurance, pest control and water and sewer also show up far more often for townhouses.

By Devin Day , Operations Officer · Reviewed by Tim Nash , Broker-in-Charge · Updated November 14, 2026
Myrtlewood Golf Club, next to Plantation Point, serves food and drink to people who do not play, and it has a patio by the Intracoastal Waterway.

The short answer
Plantation Point is a neighborhood of 352 houses in Myrtle Beach, between the US 17 Bypass and the Intracoastal Waterway, near 38th Avenue North. The nearest public beach access is about 2.7 miles away.
In the past year a typical house here sold for about $785,000. No home for sale lists a monthly HOA fee. Across the golf course, The Landing at Plantation Point has 139 smaller houses that sold for about $280,000.

## What is it like to live in Plantation Point?
The county's map shows an in-ground pool at 176 of the 352 houses here. Across Horry County, the same map shows about 1 in-ground pool for every 16 residential buildings. Our pool homes guide covers what a pool costs to keep.
U.S. government aerial photo
Part of Plantation Point from the air. The bright blue shapes behind the houses are in-ground pools.

Next door is Myrtlewood Golf Club, with two courses, PineHills and Palmetto.
"PineHills is widely regarded as the soul of Myrtle Beach golf, and its Myrtlewood sister, the Palmetto Course, as the heart." Play Golf Myrtle Beach
The clubhouse is across the course, a 10-minute drive. Our golf communities guide compares the area's golf neighborhoods.

A typical lot is about half an acre, and the smallest is about a third of an acre. The typical house is about 3,900 square feet under roof, garage included. The houses for sale this fall were built from 1987 to 2021.
Most are full-time homes: the county taxes about 85 in 100 houses here as their owner's primary residence.

### Where a normal week takes you
The nearest groceries are at the Food Lion in Plantation Point Plaza, across the bypass at 38th Avenue North.

### A little history
Myrtle Beach Farms , formed in 1912 and later Burroughs & Chapin, played a central role in the growth of Myrtle Beach. It recorded Plantation Point's restrictions in phases, starting in 1990.
Several streets share their names with old rice plantations in Georgetown County, such as Annandale, Hobcaw and Hopsewee .

Every waterway lot is in Plantation Point itself, and the map shows where they are. Two of the waterway houses sold in the past year, for $1.17 million and $1.9 million.

## Does Plantation Point have an HOA fee?
Not one of the 6 Plantation Point homes for sale lists a monthly fee, and 3 of them say there is no HOA at all. Before you offer, we find out what the association collects, if anything, for the house you pick.

- The association The only parcel the county lists for Plantation Point HOA is a small common area by the US 17 Bypass.

- The fee shown for a home for sale The listing agent enters that fee, so we confirm it with the association.

- The recorded rules Each lot comes with recorded restrictions, the neighborhood's rules. The county's index of them is online, but the documents can only be read at the Register of Deeds in Conway. We pull them for the lot you like.

- Renting County zoning has no limit on how long a home outside the towns may be rented. A subdivision's recorded rules can have one. Our short-term rental rules guide covers renting by the night.

## Is Plantation Point in the City of Myrtle Beach?
No. Every house here has a Myrtle Beach mailing address. The land is outside the city limits, in Horry County. Three things change for an owner:

- Property tax The bill has county and school tax and no city tax. The yearly figures above already count that.

- Trash The county does not collect trash at the curb. Owners hire a private hauler or use a county recycling and convenience center. The county's 25 centers are open only to residents outside the towns.

- City parking decal The city's resident parking decal is only for cars kept inside the city limits that pay city vehicle tax. Plantation Point owners do not qualify.

Our Myrtle Beach guide covers the city's own neighborhoods and what changes inside its limits.

## Is Plantation Point in a flood zone?
No house in Plantation Point or The Landing is in FEMA's high-risk zone, the zone where a lender requires flood insurance. We checked every house outline here against FEMA's map.

- Along the water A high-risk strip runs along the Intracoastal. It touches the waterway edge of 35 lots and stops short of the houses.

- Flood history A zone does not show whether a house has flooded. We check each house's flood history before you offer. Our page on flooding a seller may not mention explains how.

The course beside the lots is Myrtlewood Golf Club, with two courses, PineHills and Palmetto. Lots in both Plantation Point and The Landing border it.

Plantation Point Plaza is the shopping center at the US 17 Bypass and 38th Avenue North, with a Food Lion. It is about 8 minutes by car from the middle of Plantation Point and about 3 from The Landing.

## Palace Resort Myrtle Beach Condos for Sale: Fees From $460
